title: Duration blocks: clear them for a timed power
summary: Duration Blocks were introduced in Version 318; clearing them activates a special power that lasts for a limited time.

seo.title: Block Out Duration Blocks Obstacle Guide
seo.description: Learn how Block Out Duration Blocks activate a timed power when cleared and when to trigger that power for the most value.

rules: Duration Blocks arrived in Block Out Version 318 with the note 'Clear them and activate their special power!'.
Clearing a Duration Block triggers a special power rather than only freeing space.
The power is temporary, so its benefit expires if you do not use it promptly.
strategyPoints: Prioritize clearing Duration Blocks when the activated power directly helps the next moves.
Queue the moves you want the power to support right after the clear.
Time the clear so the power is active during the hardest part of the route.
avoidPoints: Do not clear a Duration Block early if its power will expire before you need it.
Do not waste the power on moves you could do without it.
Do not treat Duration Blocks as ordinary blockers once the power matters.
